title: The Pact
promise: One match per mode, computed for the whole campus at once. Better no match than a bad one.

none.title: No Pact right now
none.lead: Two editions a year: Valentine's Day in February, back to school in October. We'll let you know when it opens.

participants: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has joined yet} one {# person is taking part} other {# people are taking part}}
live: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody live yet} one {# person connected live} other {# people connected live}}

join.title: Join the Pact
join.consent: By taking part, your profile will be shown to your Pact match, even if you are in incognito mode. You can withdraw while sign-ups are open.
join.questionnaire: You need at least {required} questionnaire answers to take part ({answered}/{required}).
join.notJoined: You're not taking part in this edition.

errors.mode_unavailable: This mode is not enabled on your profile.
errors.profile_required: Finish your profile to take part.
errors.not_revealed: The results are not out yet.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.

waiting.title: The campus is holding its breath
waiting.lead: The reveal goes out to everyone at the same second.

sequence.announce: {count, plural, =0 {No Pact match this time.} one {Your Pact match is here.} other {Your # Pact matches are here.}}

noMatch.title: No match this time
noMatch.lead: Nobody reached the compatibility threshold with you in this edition. We'd rather not force anything.
noMatch.next: The deck is still open, and so is the next edition.

notParticipant.title: You didn't take part in this edition
notParticipant.lead: See you at the next one: Valentine's Day in February, back to school in October.
